thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: autoscaler.queue_backlog > 6000 for service=runtime-gateway in prod (policy=latency-slo). Page fired to eng-oncall.
alice_oncall: ack — seeing a spike in queue length on the metrics dashboard, latency climbing to ~2.4s  p50 -> p90. Investigating.
ben_sre: on it. grabbing recent autoscaler logs and controller metrics. any customer reports yet? @erin_support
erin_support: just got 3 chats saying timeouts on embeddings endpoint, CS is triaging. No public incident message yet.
carla_runtime: looks like continuous-batcher isn't keeping up. KV cache hit rate dropped, and some workers are OOMing and restarting. Could be a noisy model causing long seqs.
alice_oncall: good — is this autoscaler not scaling fast enough or we're starved of GPU capacity?
ben_sre: autoscaler shows scale-up events queued but reconcile loop lag is 90s. HPA targets computed but pods stuck Pending due to node shortage in the node pool.
david_pm: customers on Dedicated might see degraded throughput. Severity? If timeouts affecting production, let's treat as P1.
alice_oncall: agreed P1. @pagerduty escalate to platform-sre and runtime-eng.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation sent to platform-sre and runtime-eng. Incident created: INC-2026-318.
carla_runtime: quick mitigation — toggle autoscaler to aggressive policy and increase max replicas by +30 temporarily. I can do a manual override if we need real-time capacity.
ben_sre: before we do that, can we short-circuit non-critical routes? e.g., turn off batch embed prefetch and low-priority background reranks to free capacity.
alice_oncall: good idea. @carla_runtime can you flip routing weight to fallbacks for non-critical customers? We need to reduce incoming work by ~25%.
carla_runtime: doing routing change now. command:
```
# switch low-priority route to fallback
rbacctl routes set-weight --service runtime-gateway --route batch-prefetch --weight 0.0 --env prod
```
carla_runtime: route change pushed :white_check_mark:
alice_oncall: seeing immediate drop in new queued requests. backlog still high but trending down slowly.
ben_sre: starting manual node pool scale: aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name asg-prod-gpu --desired-capacity 24 (was 18). Triggered.
incident-bot: DeployBot: node pool scale request queued (run id 6821).
alice_oncall: also restarting the autoscaler pod to clear reconcile backlog: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/autoscaler-controller` — doing it now.
ben_sre: autoscaler pod restarted — logs show reconcile loop error due to malformed cloud quota response earlier. There's a 502 from cloud provider api.
carla_runtime: while nodes come up, I'm enabling fallback smaller-quantized model for heavy routes to reduce memory pressure: set model=llama-q4a for route /embed-large for next 10m.
alice_oncall: approved. make a note in incident ticket so we can revert.
erin_support: prepping a short customer-facing update: "We're investigating elevated latency and timeouts on embeddings; mitigation in progress. More updates in 30m." Any pushback?
david_pm: good. Also create a post-incident action to tune reconcile interval and cloud API retry backoff.
ben_sre: nodes are provisioning, kube shows new nodes Ready after ~2m. Pending pods are now scheduling.
alice_oncall: pod churn decreasing, queue length halved from peak. Latency drifting toward normal.
carla_runtime: KV cache warming — hit rate improving. I'll keep the fallback model for 15 more minutes.
alice_oncall: handing off to @oncall-next for extended monitoring. My shift ends in 20m.
oncall-next: taking over monitoring. I'll keep an eye on queue length, and if it spikes again will revert to manual autoscale.
ben_sre: note for RCA: reconcile loop lag + cloud API 502 + conservative HPA max caps combined to block scale-up.
david_pm: adding action items: 1) fallback routing playbook, 2) manual override runbook for node pools, 3) increase cloud API retries, 4) improve alert thresholds to surface reconcile lag earlier.
erin_support: posted customer update: "Mitigation underway; impacts reduced. We'll follow up when fully resolved." :white_check_mark:
alice_oncall: closing immediate page. If anything flares, re-open on this thread. Good work team. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert resolved (ack closed) — incident will remain open for postmortem.
oncall-next: will continue to monitor and update INC-2026-318. Logged current metrics snapshot to the ticket.
carla_runtime: reverting route changes in 10m if stable. Leaving fallback model active until then.
ben_sre: marking next steps in the ticket. Thanks everyone!
